roles.title: Senior/Staff Product Manager
roles.location: San Francisco, Boston, New York, Denver

bullets: Entirely own a product area and its vision and strategy, and be responsible for its success in generating value to users and to the business
Be responsible for the commercial success of your product area
Engage deeply with customers and prospects to understand users’ problems and help shape and prioritize roadmap
Collaborate with Product Marketing to establish the positioning and messaging of your product area
Partner with Customer Success and Product Marketing to manage product releases and prioritize resulting feedback
